patthana21.42:1.1: na sappaṭighaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.42:2.1: na appaṭighaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.42:3.1: na sappaṭighaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighañca na appaṭighaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. sabbattha tīṇi.
patthana21.42:4.1: na sappaṭighaṃ na anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.42:5.1: na appaṭighaṃ na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. narūpīduka nasanidassanattike rūpīduka sanidassanattikaṃ
